signal: Placer.ai raised $75M at a ~$1.45B valuation and is expanding aggressively into the government sector

email.body1:
Jake, saw Placer.ai raised $75M and is pushing hard into government, with hundreds of new buying signals to chase.

For an SDR, that means follow-up volume balloons faster than hours in the day, and good accounts go untouched simply because there's no time to reach them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?
email.body2:
Jake, quick follow-up for Placer.ai.

Most SDRs lose the most pipeline on follow-up speed and depth, the fifth and sixth touches that never go out when volume spikes. That's exactly where multi-channel sequencing earns its keep.

I'd walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change. Our best practices alone tend to lift response rates 50-70%. Want to grab 15 minutes so I can show you?
email.body3:
Jake, last bit of proof for Placer.ai.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Placer.ai's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jake, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If offloading research and follow-up isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. I know an SDR's calendar is the busiest one in the building.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Placer.ai either way.
